raw.buffDescription: When the Defender is Struck, the Attacker gains a Fury Buff granting 2.5% Attack Rating for 25 seconds. Once the Attacker has 10 Fury Buffs, any additional ones will inflict them with a stacking Passive Degeneration dealing 12% the Defender's Attack over 4 seconds.\n\nIf the Attacker lands a Heavy Attack their Fury Buffs are removed.
